name: Phantasmal Orb
desc: Obtained through Currency Wars gameplay, can be used to activate "Advantage Layout."
lore:
With the ticket THEY gave you, you stepped into the Actor's arcadia and lost yourself in happiness. When you left, all you could take with you was a crystal orb as a memento.

But that's nothing to mourn. After all, the arcadia in THEIR eyes is not the only source of joy in this world.
